title: Nal Al Jazeera Electromechanical Identity
overview: Nal Al Jazeera is a premier electromechanical contracting and integrated engineering solutions firm. We developed a comprehensive brand presentation and visual identity system rooted in precision, kinetic power, and engineering excellence. The emblem harmoniously unites lightning energy, electromechanical gear dynamism, and geometric precision built upon an exact construction grid. Complete with corporate stationery, fleet branding, and executive collateral, the brand stands out with an electric cyan and navy blue signature.

title: Trendana E-Commerce Visual Identity
overview: Trendana is an ambitious multi-category e-commerce platform built for speed, operational clarity, and customer trust. We developed a comprehensive brand identity system from core strategy and brand voice to geometric logo engineering (combining the Arabic letter 'ت', the growth trend arrow, and customer smile curve), vibrant color palettes (Kinetic Orange & Trust Navy), and cohesive touchpoints across digital apps, delivery fleet, packaging, and advertising.

title: Rawasi Brand Book & Guidelines
overview: Rawasi is a luxury contracting and engineering consultancy specializing in high-end villas, palaces, and sustainable developments. Inspired by the strength of mountains, this comprehensive Brand Book defines their timeless visual identity, geometric monogram combining Arabic and Latin lettering, desert color palette, and premium mockups designed to reflect architectural and structural excellence.
